name: @colloquial/colloquial-mcp-server

tools.name: find-fact-cards
tools.description: List the fact cards of one type (apps, assets, capabilities, features, goals, influences, information, initiatives, processes, products, services, stakeholders, strategies, or technologies) in the authenticated Colloquial workspace. Returns each card's ID, name, description, and aliases. Use get-fact-card for full details of one card.

topic_type.description: The topic type (collection) of the Fact Card

tools.name: get-fact-card
tools.description: Fetch one fact card by its type and UUID (as returned by find-fact-cards), including its fact_set (attached facts), tag and group memberships, and its connections to other fact cards.

topic_type.description: The topic type (collection) of the Fact Card

id.description: The UUID of the Fact Card

tools.name: create-fact-card
tools.description: Create a new fact card of the given topic type (app, asset, capability, feature, goal, influence, information, initiative, process, product, service, stakeholder, strategy or technology) in the authenticated Colloquial workspace.

topic_type.description: The topic type (collection) of the Fact Card

name.description: The primary name of the Fact Card. Must be unique within the workspace.

aliases.description: Alternative names for the Fact Card, separated by commas

description.description: A detailed description of the entity (10-5000 characters)

tag_ids.description: IDs of tags to associate with the Fact Card (see list-tag-groups for available tags). Replaces the existing set.

group_ids.description: UUIDs of groups to assign the Fact Card to (see list-groups, filtered by the topic's group type). Replaces the existing set; send [] to clear. Most types take a single group; technologies, assets and apps may take several. Stakeholders are not groupable. A UUID that is unknown or of the wrong group type is rejected with a 422.

tools.name: update-fact-card
tools.description: Update an existing fact card. Only the provided fields change. Set archived=true to archive (or false to restore) — prefer archiving over delete-fact-card.

topic_type.description: The topic type (collection) of the Fact Card

id.description: The UUID of the Fact Card

name.description: The primary name of the Fact Card. Must be unique within the workspace.

aliases.description: Alternative names for the Fact Card, separated by commas

description.description: A detailed description of the entity (10-5000 characters)

tag_ids.description: IDs of tags to associate with the Fact Card (see list-tag-groups for available tags). Replaces the existing set.

group_ids.description: UUIDs of groups to assign the Fact Card to (see list-groups, filtered by the topic's group type). Replaces the existing set; send [] to clear. Most types take a single group; technologies, assets and apps may take several. Stakeholders are not groupable. A UUID that is unknown or of the wrong group type is rejected with a 422.

archived.description: Set true to archive the Fact Card, false to restore it

tools.name: delete-fact-card
tools.description: Permanently delete a fact card. This cannot be undone — to hide a card while keeping its history, archive it with update-fact-card instead.

topic_type.description: The topic type (collection) of the Fact Card

id.description: The UUID of the Fact Card

tools.name: list-relations
tools.description: List relations (typed connections) between fact cards in the workspace, optionally filtered by the fact card types involved and/or relationship pattern. Paginated.

types.description: Filter by the fact card types involved, e.g. ["apps", "technologies"]

tools.name: get-relation
tools.description: Fetch an individual relation between two fact cards by its UUID.

id.description: The UUID of the relation

tools.name: create-relation
tools.description: Create a relation between two existing fact cards, e.g. an app depending on a technology. Find card UUIDs with find-fact-cards first.

source_uuid.description: The UUID of the source Fact Card

target_uuid.description: The UUID of the target Fact Card

definition.description: An optional description of this specific relationship

tools.name: update-relation
tools.description: Update an existing relation between fact cards. Only the provided fields change.

id.description: The UUID of the relation

source_uuid.description: The UUID of the source Fact Card

target_uuid.description: The UUID of the target Fact Card

definition.description: An optional description of this specific relationship

tools.name: delete-relation
tools.description: Permanently delete a relation between two fact cards. This cannot be undone. The fact cards themselves are not affected.

id.description: The UUID of the relation

tools.name: list-facts
tools.description: List facts (dated attribute records) across the workspace or for one fact card. Defaults to live facts only; pass state to include future/expired/superseded/ignored ones. Paginated.

topic_id.description: Filter to a single Fact Card (topic) by UUID

response_type.description: Restrict results to one fact kind

template_id.description: Filter to a single template by its uuid (implies its response_type). Deprecated: a legacy integer template id also needs response_type.

state.description: Filter by state, or "all". Defaults to live facts only.

tools.name: list-fact-templates
tools.description: List the fact templates a card can carry, optionally scoped to one topic type. Each entry gives the template_id (for create-fact), its priority (required/recommended/optional — how obliged a card is to carry the fact), response_type, description, review_days, lifecycle, and a value_hint describing the create-fact value payload (including the allowed scale_values for choice templates). This is the source of truth for which facts a card of a given type is expected to have.

topic_type.description: Restrict the catalogue to one topic type (e.g. capabilities). Omit for the whole workspace catalogue.

tools.name: get-fact
tools.description: Fetch an individual fact by kind and id. Compound kinds (calculated, quadrant) cannot be fetched individually — use list-facts for those.

response_type.description: The fact kind. Compound kinds (calculated, quadrant) are derived and read-only.

id.description: The fact identifier (UUID or numeric, depending on the fact kind)

tools.name: create-fact
tools.description: Record a fact against a fact card. The value payload depends on the fact kind: number/currency/date/date_range/external/rich_text/unrestricted take {"response": ...}; link_with_status takes {"href": "...", "status": "..."}; choice takes {"scale_value_id": <int>}; multistep takes {"score": <number>}; stakeholder takes {"stakeholder": "<uuid>", "role": "..."} or {"partner_user_id": <int>, "role": "..."}.

topic_id.description: The UUID of the Fact Card the fact belongs to

response_type.description: The fact kind. Compound kinds (calculated, quadrant) are derived and read-only.

template_id.description: The uuid of the template this fact answers (template_id in list-fact-templates). Deprecated: a legacy integer template id is still accepted.

user_id.description: The user id credited as contributor (must be an active member — see list-users)

justification.description: Why this fact is believed to be true

begins_at.description: Trust period start date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today)

ends_at.description: Trust period end date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today + the template's trust period)

value.description: The kind-specific value payload (see tool description)

tools.name: renew-fact
tools.description: Renew a fact: a freshly-dated copy supersedes the original, extending its trust period without changing the value.

response_type.description: The fact kind. Compound kinds (calculated, quadrant) are derived and read-only.

id.description: The fact identifier (UUID or numeric, depending on the fact kind)

user_id.description: The user id credited as contributor (must be an active member — see list-users)

tools.name: create-template
tools.description: Create a fact template: the definition of a fact Fact Cards can carry. Responds with the same entry list-fact-templates returns, ready for create-fact. choice templates take options; other response types are coming soon. Pass applicable_topic_types: without it the template applies to no topic type and never appears in list-fact-templates for one.

response_type.description: The kind of fact the template captures

name.description: The template name, unique within the workspace

template_group_id.description: The Fact Group to file the template in (see list-template-groups; defaults to the workspace's default group for the response type)

justification.description: Whether a justification is optional, available, or required alongside each fact (default none)

applicable_topic_types.description: The topic types the template applies to (replaces the existing set on update). A type not enabled in the workspace is accepted with a warning.

priority.description: Whether a Fact Card must, should, or may carry this fact (default optional)

review_days.description: How many days a fact stays trusted before review (default 365)

lifecycle.description: How the fact behaves over its review period (default trusted)

options.description: For choice templates, the answers to choose from, in display order. A new option needs name, definition and color. Options cannot be removed through the API.

id.description: On update, the option to edit (a scale_values id from list-fact-templates); omit to add a new option

tools.name: update-template
tools.description: Update a fact template by its uuid (template_id in list-fact-templates). Only the provided fields change; response_type cannot be changed, and connector-managed templates cannot be edited.

id.description: The template's uuid

name.description: The template name, unique within the workspace

template_group_id.description: The Fact Group to file the template in (see list-template-groups; defaults to the workspace's default group for the response type)

justification.description: Whether a justification is optional, available, or required alongside each fact (default none)

applicable_topic_types.description: The topic types the template applies to (replaces the existing set on update). A type not enabled in the workspace is accepted with a warning.

priority.description: Whether a Fact Card must, should, or may carry this fact (default optional)

review_days.description: How many days a fact stays trusted before review (default 365)

lifecycle.description: How the fact behaves over its review period (default trusted)

options.description: For choice templates, the answers to choose from, in display order. A new option needs name, definition and color. Options cannot be removed through the API.

id.description: On update, the option to edit (a scale_values id from list-fact-templates); omit to add a new option

tools.name: list-template-groups
tools.description: List the Fact Groups templates are filed under, in display order. Their ids are what create-template and update-template accept as template_group_id.

tools.name: list-groups
tools.description: List the hierarchical groups fact cards can belong to (e.g. CapabilityGroup, TechnologyGroup), optionally filtered by type. Paginated via limit/offset.

type.description: Filter groups by type, e.g. "CapabilityGroup" or "TechnologyGroup"

limit.description: Maximum number of groups to return (default 100, max 1000)

offset.description: Number of groups to skip for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: get-group
tools.description: Fetch an individual group by its UUID, including its type, hierarchy position and status.

id.description: The UUID of the group

tools.name: create-group
tools.description: Create a new group in the hierarchy (e.g. a CapabilityGroup or TechnologyGroup). Root groups (no parent_id) may also define value stages via value_stages_attributes.

definition.description: The definition or description of the group

parent_id.description: The UUID of the parent group

id.description: The UUID of an existing value stage to update or remove (omit to create a new one)

name.description: The name of the value stage

description.description: The description of the value stage

position.description: The position of the value stage within the group

width.description: The column width of the value stage (1-12)

_destroy.description: Set to true (with an id) to remove the value stage

value_stages_attributes.description: Value stages to create, update, or remove on the group. Only permitted on root groups (those without a parent). Include an id to update or remove an existing stage, or _destroy: true to remove it.

tools.name: update-group
tools.description: Update an existing group. Only the provided fields change. value_stages_attributes is only permitted on root groups (those without a parent) — include an id to update or remove an existing stage, or omit id to add a new one.

id.description: The UUID of the group

definition.description: The definition or description of the group

parent_id.description: The UUID of the parent group

id.description: The UUID of an existing value stage to update or remove (omit to create a new one)

name.description: The name of the value stage

description.description: The description of the value stage

position.description: The position of the value stage within the group

width.description: The column width of the value stage (1-12)

_destroy.description: Set to true (with an id) to remove the value stage

value_stages_attributes.description: Value stages to create, update, or remove on the group. Only permitted on root groups (those without a parent). Include an id to update or remove an existing stage, or _destroy: true to remove it.

tools.name: delete-group
tools.description: Permanently delete a group. This cannot be undone, and fails if the group has child groups.

id.description: The UUID of the group

tools.name: list-tag-groups
tools.description: List all tag groups and their tags. Tag ids from here are what create-fact-card and update-fact-card accept as tag_ids.

status.description: Filter tag groups by status (default "active", which also hides disabled tags inside each group)

tools.name: get-tag-group
tools.description: Fetch an individual tag group by its id.

id.description: The unique identifier of the tag group

tools.name: create-tag-group
tools.description: Create a new tag group.

name.description: The name of the tag group (must be unique within your workspace)

definition.description: Describes the purpose of this tag group

icon.description: The icon that represents this Tag Group

color.description: The hex colour used when displaying this Tag Group

status.description: The status of the object. Setting to disabled also disables all tags in the group; setting it back to active re-enables the group only — its tags stay disabled and must be re-enabled individually.

tools.name: update-tag-group
tools.description: Update an existing tag group. name, definition and icon must all be supplied (the API replaces them, it does not merge).

id.description: The unique identifier of the tag group

name.description: The name of the tag group (must be unique within your workspace)

definition.description: Describes the purpose of this tag group

icon.description: The icon that represents this Tag Group

color.description: The hex colour used when displaying this Tag Group

status.description: The status of the object. Setting to disabled also disables all tags in the group; setting it back to active re-enables the group only — its tags stay disabled and must be re-enabled individually.

tools.name: delete-tag-group
tools.description: Permanently delete a tag group. This cannot be undone.

id.description: The unique identifier of the tag group

tools.name: list-tags
tools.description: List tags, optionally filtered by tag group or status. Paginated via page/per_page.

tag_group_id.description: Filter tags by the tag group they belong to

status.description: Filter tags by status. By default tags of every status are returned.

per_page.description: Number of results per page (default 25, max 100)

tools.name: get-tag
tools.description: Fetch an individual tag by its id.

id.description: The unique identifier of the tag

tools.name: create-tag
tools.description: Create a new tag within a tag group. See list-tag-groups for available tag_group_id values.

name.description: The name of the tag (must be unique within its tag group)

tag_group_id.description: The ID of the tag group this tag belongs to. On update, moving a tag to a tag group in another workspace is not allowed.

color.description: The hex colour used when displaying the tag

tools.name: update-tag
tools.description: Update an existing tag. name and tag_group_id must both be supplied (the API replaces them, it does not merge). Moving a tag to a tag group in another workspace is not allowed.

id.description: The unique identifier of the tag

name.description: The name of the tag (must be unique within its tag group)

tag_group_id.description: The ID of the tag group this tag belongs to. On update, moving a tag to a tag group in another workspace is not allowed.

color.description: The hex colour used when displaying the tag

tools.name: delete-tag
tools.description: Permanently delete a tag. This cannot be undone.

id.description: The unique identifier of the tag

tools.name: list-views
tools.description: List the workspace's active views (canvases over the group hierarchy), optionally filtered by visibility or layout. Paginated via limit/offset.

layout.description: The canvas the view is built on: "<Class>Group" for a group-only canvas (e.g. "CapabilityGroup"), or "<Class>Group__FactCard::<Class>" for an extended canvas that also renders Fact Cards (e.g. "CapabilityGroup__FactCard::Capability"). <Class> is the singular Fact Card class name, not the plural topic_type: processes are "BusinessProcessGroup".

limit.description: Maximum number of views to return (default 100, max 1000)

offset.description: Number of views to skip for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: get-view
tools.description: Fetch an individual view by its UUID, including its layout, visibility, manager and collections.

id.description: The UUID of the view

tools.name: create-view
tools.description: Create a view on a canvas, with every root group visible. Defaults to a draft private to its manager; publishing needs at least one view_collection_id. Sharing with specific members or teams is done in the app. An invalid layout is rejected with the list of canvases enabled for the workspace.

name.description: The name of the view (its slug is derived from it)

layout.description: The canvas the view is built on: "<Class>Group" for a group-only canvas (e.g. "CapabilityGroup"), or "<Class>Group__FactCard::<Class>" for an extended canvas that also renders Fact Cards (e.g. "CapabilityGroup__FactCard::Capability"). <Class> is the singular Fact Card class name, not the plural topic_type: processes are "BusinessProcessGroup".

user_id.description: The member the view is created on behalf of; they author it and become its manager (see list-users). Required with an API key; an OAuth token defaults to the authorising user.

visibility.description: draft (default) keeps the view private to its manager; published makes it visible to the whole organisation and requires view_collection_ids

featured.description: Whether to highlight the view in the app

view_collection_ids.description: The collections to file the view under (see list-view-collections). Required when publishing.

tools.name: list-view-collections
tools.description: List the collections views are filed under, in display order. Their ids are what create-view accepts as view_collection_ids.

tools.name: list-users
tools.description: List all workspace users (id, name, email). User ids from here are what create-fact and renew-fact accept as user_id.
